structure.unit: Taxes Administered by the Department of Taxation

law.catch_line: Purchase of tobacco products for resale
law.text:
No retail dealer shall purchase tobacco products, for resale to consumers, from any person within or outside the Commonwealth of Virginia, except as follows:
A retail dealer purchases from a distributor licensed by the Commonwealth of Virginia.
A retail dealer applies for and is granted a license as a distributor, and files returns and maintains records as required of licensed distributors under this article.
